hypothesis: Recent residual heads learned from only 4,437 D6 OOF races. A standalone pairwise ranker trained on every strictly prior race can use 50k-plus histories without requiring leaked parent predictions, then contribute a small fixed orthogonal correction to v283.

training_rows.full: all races strictly before each validation fold from fixed fold_indices
training_rows.screen: fixed screen_train_indices from candidate acceleration cache
training_rows.pair_labels: top1 beats the other five, top2 beats the four below it, top3 beats the three outside top3; bottom3 pair order is unknown and omitted
training_rows.orientation: include both directions for every known comparison

features.pair_projection: signed runner_i minus runner_j and absolute difference, plus race context
features.missing_handling: LightGBM native missing; official course missing remains sidecar zeros with course_available zero

prediction.runner_score: mean opponent logit P(runner_i beats runner_j), centered across six runners

promotion_requires: mean delta versus v283 below zero, race-date bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v283 child-family Holm-adjusted p below 0.05
difference_from_v292: v292 fit a parent residual on only prior OOF folds. v293 learns an independent comparison model from all strictly prior raw races and uses v283 only at prediction time.
